chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

From Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When Allah, Exalted and Glorious, created Adam (peace be upon him), He breathed into him from the Spirit. The first part of his body He looked at was his belly, then He looked at his head, then his eyes, then his nose, then his mouth, then his tongue, then his lips, then his teeth, then his gums, then his throat, then his neck, then his shoulders, then his arms, then his hands, then his chest, then his belly, then his back, then his thighs, then his knees, then his shins, then his feet, then the toes of his feet, then the fingers of his hands, then the hair of his head, then his beard, then his eyes, then his ears, then his skin, then his flesh, then his bones, then his blood, then his sinews, then his veins, then his arteries, then his sweat, then his skin surface, then the hair of his body, then his nails, then the rest of his body. He said: "O Adam, you are My creation and I have chosen you over many of My creation, so prostrate to Me." Adam (peace be upon him) prostrated. Then Allah, Exalted and Glorious, said: "O Adam, rise to your loins, for I will bring forth from you offspring."'

key_terms.الرُّوحِ: The Spirit, often referring to the divine breath or soul
key_terms.صُلْبِكَ: Your loins/flanks, referring to the source of progeny

ai.seo_question: What happened when Allah first created Adam and looked at his body?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this narrative within the doctrine of *Alam al-Dhar* (the Realm of Souls), where Allah inspected the loins of Adam to extract all future progeny, establishing the physical and spiritual lineage of humanity. This event underscores the divine predestination and the unique status of Adam as the first prophet and the physical ancestor of the Imams, linking the creation of the body to the subsequent revelation of the soul.
